capabilities: Highlight prose, inline code and code lines or exact ranges
Apply named semantic presets and attach annotations
Search highlights across a note, folder, vault or collection with filters
Export excerpts as formatted text, plain text, blockquotes or code fences
Migrate highlights from Highlightr, Hilo and fence line markers
extras: Desktop only (Windows, macOS, Linux). Keyboard navigation, pop-out windows, PDF export and migration steps are documented in an external user guide; syntax data is bundled and works offline.
problem: Obsidian's built-in highlight is one unlabelled color and cannot mark individual code lines, so passages cannot be tagged by meaning and found again across notes.

relations.evidence: The built-in syntax module incorporates their theme mappings, display configuration and styles

summary: Highlights prose, inline code and code lines or ranges with shared semantic colors, plus a searchable highlight workbench and excerpt export.
